## Problem or use case

Describe the problem, research need, or user workflow this feature would address.

## Proposed change

Describe the capability or behavior you would like to see.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any workarounds or alternative approaches you considered.

## Correctness and performance considerations

Note any expected semantic, compatibility, memory, concurrency, or performance implications. Performance claims should be supported by reproducible evidence rather than assumptions.

## Additional context

Add relevant references, examples, or public datasets if useful.
